verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a SaaS security scanner, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack never documents a way to disable telemetry or usage tracking. The hybrid deployment, where the scanner and AI inference run in the customer's AWS account, is a data-residency feature, not a telemetry opt-out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
